summary: Mu-native MCP config precedence and import parsing match the mission spec after fixing Codex TOML section leakage.

findings.message: The loader now imports `.factory/mcp.json` and `~/.codex/config.toml`, then overlays Mu user config and project config in that order.
Non-MCP TOML sections now reset the active MCP table, so later Codex sections like `[[skills.config]]` no longer pollute the last MCP server entry.
The targeted suite proves `.factory` JSON import, Codex TOML import, precedence, and explicit non-dependence on `~/.codex/config.json`.
